generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The import is necessary for the annotation.
Directly assigns `null` for pre-8.14.0 versions instead of calling `fromTypeName("unknown")`. Wire format compatibility is preserved (no string is read from the stream in either version).
The `@Nullable` annotation properly documents the contract on the field.
The `case null, default` in the switch expression correctly handles the null case, falling through to the raw term query path.

review_comment:
`default` doesn't include nulls for enums (As enums call `v.ordinal()` in switches), and it throws unless an explicit null case is added.
Another interesting thing, is that the `case null, default` syntax is the only way to combine null or default cases!
